A user has filed a support ticket reporting that their experience
with the service has degraded — requests feel slow or are failing
for them. The on-call team needs you to investigate.

Telemetry parquets are stored in: `.`
Available files: abnormal_metrics.parquet, abnormal_traces.parquet,
abnormal_logs.parquet, abnormal_metrics_histogram.parquet,
abnormal_metrics_sum.parquet, normal_metrics.parquet,
normal_traces.parquet, normal_logs.parquet.

Walk the telemetry to identify which endpoints / services are
actually affected, then determine the root cause(s) of the
degradation.

content.text: I'll start by listing the tables and their schemas.
Next I'll compare per-service span counts, error share and latency between the normal and abnormal periods.

input.query: SELECT 'normal' p, service_name, attr_span_kind k, count(*) n, avg(duration)/1e6 avg_ms, quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6 p95_ms, avg((attr_status_code='Error')::int) err FROM normal_traces GROUP BY 1,2,3 UNION ALL SELECT 'abnormal', service_name, attr_span_kind, count(*), avg(duration)/1e6, quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6, avg((attr_status_code='Error')::int) FROM abnormal_traces GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 2,3,1
